decision.message: changes a user on the node: adds it to the groups, sets the shell and writes the SSH keys of this plan
decision.hint: read the keys this plan adds and takes out: logins with a key taken out stop working, and a group such as sudo or docker makes the user root

warnings.message: user app is added to group docker on web: its members control the Docker daemon, which runs containers as root with the host's files, so the user can become root there
warnings.hint: declare the group only if the user is meant to administer the node; Mamela never removes a membership, so taking it out of the declaration later does not take it away

warnings.message: user app on web is also in group adm, which the declaration does not name: Mamela adds memberships and never removes one, so it stays
warnings.hint: declare the group if it is meant, or take the user out of it by hand (gpasswd -d app adm)
